Let impurity not be called the cause of action; action is not from impurity, since action is activity-natured.
Activity comes from the form of agency and freedom, not again from impurity; action-hood is the varied fruit-giving of this action.
That well-known action-hood is not without contraction in the self; impurity regards varied different fruit as enjoyable.
In the enjoyer-self, this difference-form arrangement exists; thus it resorts to cooperation in the production of its own work.
Impurity is the cause as power-manifesting of action; but if action exists, how can impurity also exist?
Limited knowledge has contraction; such contraction indeed exists; even destroyed contraction becomes firm by meditation.
Thinking 'I am not the doer,' one abandons action impression; the firm disposition in the self says this action will fruit.

Fruit does not arise for the intoxicated or deluded, nor when penance is done; austerity performed by me today would clearly be for him.
Action of an intentional agent does not fruit from intention; but intention-named action in the mental sphere is impression.
Producing fruit-stained action becomes fit for fruit attainment; whoever even there with firmness abandons fruit impression.
He enjoys a special fruit made by abandoning that fruit; by this method one abandons all action-continuity.
With non-ego union one should abandon; even the limited one with contraction should do so; but some wrong action is own and intentional.
Real speech would not be known to another by you; if the enjoyer's intention were as in oneself, it would differ.

In absence of intention there is no fruit-connection; the convention 'wrong action is mine' is for fruitlessness.
In cutting another's intention, not intended by self, fruit would not be for both due to destruction-cause arrangement.
In pleasure-cause and pleasure of this, from common intention even from undifferentiated, just enjoyment of virtue-etc fruit.
Suffering or suffering-cause would be thus mine; but common intention would not be of that unrighteousness, nor scripture.
We speak the topic of the described limited knower: with non-ego union all action impressions are dissolved.
Therefore for this one action does not exist; impurity may do cooperation for anyone, and by that this one attains destruction-nature.
With destroyed impurity, controlled by inner Shiva possession, even ego-state goes, not action-dependent condition.
Said in holy previous scripture by the supreme lord: they desire impurity as ignorance, cause of the world sprout.

quick_english: Function-share thus, that place, sound grasps sufficiently — so, he who says ear-space, ear-contact-divided.
Sound-born cognition arises when sound comes; even a faint drum sound, if heard, counts.
How can perception occur at a distance? Not so: sound-born sound is uttered from far and far.
What is in ear-space has far-and-far nature; that first sound is not pervasive, and this is fitting.
With those there, the intense-natured is heard by this; but how would the faint be heard? Not so, since it rests on another quality.
This was refuted by others in many ways; vain again. Who indeed is not a scholar in giving a blow to the fallen?
But of these, earth and the rest, as many tattva-group as before, standing by greater quality, pervaded, so much shines.
The pervaded-pervader relation shown of the tattvas is established by greater quality, not by causality nor by simplicity.
Even without cause, attachment is clearly pervaded by knowing and so forth; without that, what is called pervaded would not be, since.
No simplicity indeed exists here in own view; by greater quality the pervaded-pervader relation is known clearly.
Who indeed is superior in quality from that is called above; aboveness is pervader-ness, clear in Sri Malinivijaya.
Therefore from Sivahood taking light-nature in own self, earth shines with all tattva-chain qualities; pervader-ness is established enough.
Thus for water and so forth up to Sakti-tattva abode form exists such; but higher is Sakti-tattva, lower is its quality, difference.
This has been shown in the supreme procedure by vaitatya; therefore the discerning one who desires expansion should look further.
Thus the form of tattva has been properly illuminated.
